t: Chemical Reaction Kinetics Simulator — Overview and definition
description: Integrates reaction mechanisms to predict species, heat release, and ignition.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Integrates reaction mechanisms to predict species, heat release, and ignition. A chemical reaction kinetics simulator integrates stiff ODE systems for detailed mechanisms (hundreds of species and reactions) to predict ignition delay, flame speed, and pollutant formation. Real implementations include Cantera, Chemkin, and Reaction Mechanism Generator. It performs sensitivity analysis to find rate-limiting steps and reduces mechanisms for CFD.

body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Chemical Reaction Kinetics Simulator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Stiff integration of detailed mechanisms). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Stiff integration of detailed mechanisms and 0D reactors, 1D flames, and shock tubes. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Combustion kinetics simulation engine) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
